question: Which of the following political parties announced a nationwide protest on November 18, 2025, against rising atrocities on marginalized groups in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Communist Party of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Communist Party of India (CPI)** has officially announced its plan to organize a **nationwide protest** scheduled for **November 18, 2025**.
 
• The primary motive behind this call for action is to express strong dissent against the increasing **atrocities** and systemic violence targeting **marginalized groups**, including **Dalits**, **Adivasis**, and **minority communities** across the country.
 
• The decision was finalized during a meeting of the **National Executive** of the party, where leaders raised concerns about the perceived failure of administrative machinery in protecting vulnerable sections of society.
 
• The protest aims to mobilize **party cadres**, **trade unions**, and **peasant organizations** at the **district** and **state levels** to demand justice and better security for these groups.
